title: Edible moss
description: Edible moss and glowing edible moss
body:
This mod adds edible moss crafted from moss block or moss carpet. I know maybe giving that big stats to moss is too much (maybe i change it in the future) but who cares, me not. I just wanted to make a mod which let you eat moss. I hope you like being able to eat MOSS. :)

This mod also ads a music disk but its a secret so shhhh...

 

 

You can do mostly anything with this mod as you want but:

-Don't reupload it as your own work (unless you want to create port, then credit me as the original author

-IDK just don't steal my work

 

This mod was made in MCreator

Evething except music was made by me (or at least I don't rebember anything else)

Music used in this mod is created by Toby Fox and is used for non-commercial, fan-made purposes. All rights belong to the original creator.
